passage.text: On Monday, Mr. Brown gets up at half past five.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈɡɛts ˈʌp ət ˈhæf ˈpæst ˈfaɪv.

passage.text: He has breakfast and goes to the university.
passage.reading: hiː ˈhæz ˈbrɛkfəst ənd ˈɡoʊz tə ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: He teaches two lessons in the morning.
passage.reading: hiː ˈtiːtʃɪz ˈtuː ˈlɛsənz ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: After the lessons, he has lunch with his students.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ðə ˈlɛsənz, hiː ˈhæz ˈlʌntʃ wɪð hɪz ˈstuːdənts.

passage.text: He goes home at six o'clock.
passage.reading: hiː ˈɡoʊz ˈhoʊm ət ˈsɪks əˈklɑːk.

passage.text: In the evening, he cooks dinner and reads a book.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ, hiː ˈkʊks ˈdɪnər ənd ˈriːdz ə ˈbʊk.
